gloss: one way or another; all in all; when all is said and done

definitions.gloss: one way or another; for various reasons; despite everything
definitions.explanation: Indicates that despite various circumstances, complications, or concerns, something ultimately happens or is true. Often implies acceptance of a result after considering multiple factors.

definitions.gloss: all in all; when all is said and done; in the end
definitions.explanation: Used to summarize or conclude after considering various aspects, often revealing a positive underlying truth despite surface-level complaints or issues.

examples.japanese: なんだかんだ{言|い}っても、{彼|かれ}は{頼|たよ}りになる。
examples.english: When all is said and done, he's someone you can rely on.

examples.japanese: なんだかんだで{間|ま}に{合|あ}った。
examples.english: One way or another, I made it in time.

examples.japanese: {文句|もんく}を{言|い}いながらも、なんだかんだ{楽|たの}しんでいる。
examples.english: Despite complaining, they're enjoying it all in all.

examples.japanese: なんだかんだで{二人|ふたり}は{十年|じゅうねん}{以上|いじょう}{付|つ}き{合|あ}っている。
examples.english: One way or another, those two have been together for over ten years.

examples.japanese: なんだかんだ{言|い}っても、{母|はは}の{料理|りょうり}が{一番|いちばん}{美味|おい}しい。
examples.english: When all is said and done, my mother's cooking is the best.

examples.japanese: {忙|いそが}しいと{言|い}いつつ、なんだかんだで{毎週|まいしゅう}{飲|の}みに{行|い}っている。
examples.english: Even though they say they're busy, one way or another they go out drinking every week.

examples.japanese: なんだかんだあったけど、{最終的|さいしゅうてき}には{全員|ぜんいん}{無事|ぶじ}に{帰|かえ}れてよかった。
examples.english: A lot happened, but in the end I'm glad everyone made it home safely.

examples.japanese: なんだかんだで{締|し}め{切|き}りに{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせるのが{得意|とくい}だ。
examples.english: One way or another, I'm good at making deadlines.

notes:
PATTERNS:
・なんだかんだ{言|い}って(も) - When all is said and done; despite what one says
・なんだかんだで - One way or another; for various reasons
・なんだかんだ + positive statement (often reveals underlying truth)

NUANCE:
Often used to express that despite surface-level negativity (complaints, problems, complications), the underlying reality is positive or acceptable. Common in conversational Japanese.

VARIANT:
・なんのかんの(と){言|い}って - Same meaning (slightly more formal variant)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・{結局|けっきょく} - In the end, after all
・いろいろあって - After various things (happened)
・やっぱり - As expected, after all
